resource: Entries in one OPEN_CONTAINER view (domain 11 snapshot type 1 or delta type 1) of a session that selected capability 514 CORPSE_CONTAINER_48_V1
allocation_impact: The decoder refuses a 49th corpse entry before decoding it and any payload over 1499 bytes (the container handle and 48 entries of at most 31 bytes) before reading it; the encoder refuses the same view before emitting a byte. With capability 499 also selected, entry elements are at most 35 bytes and the bound is 1691 bytes. Live item handles grow by the 18 extra entries.
boundary_tests: max=48: a corpse with 48 entries round-trips within 1499 bytes
max+1=49: 49 entries are refused in both directions
capability 499: 48-entry views round-trip with 35-byte entry elements within 1691 bytes
without 514: 31 entries are still refused and the server shows only the first 30
notes: CORPSE48 owner decision (2026-11-17): the corpse view capacity equals GAMEITEM01-CORPSE-CONTAINER-ENTRIES-MAX (48). Within FND02-STATE-DELTA-PAYLOAD-BYTES and FND02-SNAPSHOT-CHUNK-BYTES.
